title: Width-zero gate functions are constant
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f:\{\pm1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$, and let $G$ be an AND or OR gate. Suppose $f$ has a representation of width at most zero in the normal form associated with $G$ (CNF for AND and DNF for OR). Then $f$ is constant: there is a sign $c\in\{\pm1\}$ such that $f(x)=c$ for every input $x$.
